# split_band_by_max_r_subpeaks { #mofography.pocket_typing.split_band_by_max_r_subpeaks }

```python
pocket_typing.split_band_by_max_r_subpeaks(
    pocket_ids,
    fps,
    d1_by_rep,
    *,
    subsplit_gap_a=DEFAULT_MAX_R_SUBSPLIT_GAP_A,
    split_cosine=FP_MERGE_COSINE,
)
```

Split one max_r band when grid peaks differ in radius and annulus fingerprint.

E.g. ZIF ~2.74 vs ~2.79 Å (split). UiO ~3.78 vs ~3.90 after singleton merge (keep merged
when fingerprints still match).
